bo: gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha rnams sangs rgyas kyi bsngags pa rgya cher brjod cing
target: khang pa'i steng du song ste sa brgyad la gnas nas de nam gyi gung la bab pa'i dus kyi tshe gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha rnams sangs rgyas kyi bsngags pa rgya cher brjod cing bar snang la 'gro ba dang / chos dang / dge 'dun gyi bsngags pa rgya cher brjod cing 'gro ba thos so/ /
